author.name: Elena Rostova
author.bio: Writing compute shaders and WebGPU raymarching pipelines.

flows.title: 100k GPU Particles with WGSL Compute Shaders in 3 Minutes
flows.description: A breakdown of high-performance particle velocity ping-pong buffers using WebGPU storage buffers and ping-pong render passes.
flows.content:
In this walkthrough, we bypass CPU bottlenecking by driving 100,000 particles entirely on the GPU compute pass.

1. Allocate ping-pong storage buffers with GPUBufferUsage.STORAGE | GPUBufferUsage.COPY_DST.
2. Bind the previous position buffer as read-only and next position buffer as read-write in the compute bind group.
3. Apply Curl Noise directly in the compute shader to generate organic vector flow fields with zero main-thread hitching.

author.name: Kai Tanaka
author.bio: Procedural audio engines and physical modeling in Web Audio API.

flows.title: Physical Acoustic Modeling with Karplus-Strong Algorithm
flows.description: How to synthesize plucked acoustic guitar strings in real time using a feedback delay loop with low-pass damping in an AudioWorkletProcessor.
flows.content:
Karplus-Strong creates convincing physical string models by exciting a delay line with white noise and feeding it back through an averaging filter.

1. Generate an initial burst of noise equal to the period length (SampleRate / Frequency).
2. On each cycle, average adjacent samples: y[n] = 0.5 * (x[n] + x[n-1]) * decay.
3. This creates natural high-frequency dampening identical to vibrating nylon or steel strings.

author.name: Maya Lin
author.bio: Crafting fluid UI gesture physics and mathematical transitions.

flows.title: Runge-Kutta 4 (RK4) Spring Integrator for Tactile Gestures
flows.description: Replacing standard Euler integration with RK4 to eliminate velocity drift and oscillation explosions during high-frequency gesture dragging.
flows.content:
Euler integration (pos += vel * dt) rapidly accumulates floating-point energy during stiff springs (tension > 500). RK4 evaluates velocity derivatives at 4 checkpoints per tick.

Result: Zero overshooting instability even with ultra-snappy micro-animations and zero frame drops on 120Hz ProMotion displays.

author.name: Devon Thorne
author.bio: Building SNARK verifiers, Poseidon hashing, and anonymous credentials.

flows.title: Zero-Knowledge Merkle Membership in 42 Constraints
flows.description: Optimizing Poseidon sponge hash rounds to verify tree inclusion proofs inside Circom circuits with minimal prover time.
flows.content:
Traditional SHA-256 inside SNARKs consumes ~25,000 R1CS constraints per block. Switching to Poseidon over the BN254 scalar field reduces this to under 240 constraints per level!

In this breakdown, see the exact circuit architecture to prove you belong to a verified creator pool without revealing your address or identity.
